skill.summary: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the frontend-design skill.
- Generates production-grade frontend interfaces with bold, distinctive aesthetics.
- Guides users to select extreme, memorable design directions and execute them with precision.
- Focuses on creative typography, committed color themes, impactful motion, and sophisticated layout.
- Explicitly avoids generic AI-driven design conventions and encourages unique, context-specific solutions.
